output_test.note: Model resolved and billed successfully as claude-opus-5 (MODEL_MAP in output-test.py has no entry for it, so the literal string was passed straight to the API and accepted). Unlike R1-R5's 1500-token attempt (0 visible words), 4000 tokens was enough for a partial, visible completion. The completion (output-reference.md) opened by announcing it would read CLAUDE.md and inventory the KB files, matching <task_roadmap> step 1 exactly -- a real, if incomplete, structural-compliance signal. output-test.py's own built-in scorer (Phase 3: structural/prior_art/assertions/schema) gave FAIL/2.0 -- this is a known category mismatch: that scorer expects a direct single-turn completion to already contain the deliverable content, but this prompt's deliverables (4 markdown files under research/GRILL/) require an actual agentic Read/Write/Bash loop that a raw messages.create() call without tool access cannot perform. The FAIL/2.0 reflects the harness's scoring-engine mismatch for agentic file-writing prompts, not a defect found in the prompt; the cost/token/model-resolution data and the correctly-ordered opening are the genuine signal from this call.
